name: IndusQ-1.1B
headline: State-of-the-art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks.
description: Indus is today a 1.2 billion parameter model and has been supervised fine tuned for Hindi and dialects.

technical_details.key: Input sequence length for Prompt Processor

technical_details.string_value: Rate of response generation after the first response token.

Time To First Token is the time it takes to generate the first response token. This is expressed as a range because it varies based on the length of the prompt. The lower bound is for a short prompt (up to 128 tokens, i.e., one iteration of the prompt processor) and the upper bound is for a prompt using the full context length (1024 tokens).
Initiate conversation with prompt-processor and then token generator for subsequent iterations.
